---
title: "Welcome!"
subtitle: "You can find my projects, technical notes, publications, and resume on this site. My professional experience is plotted below."
lightbox: true
---



```{r}
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(gganimate)
library(av)
```


```{r}
#| include: false

#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| cache: true



# --- Data ---
df <- tibble(
  activity = c(
    "Human Biomarkers Researcher",
    "Assistant Research Specialist", "MA in Medical Anthropology", "PhD in Biological Anthropology",
    "Graduate Research Assistant", "Data Analyst", "Graduate Research Assistant",
    "Senior Data Analyst", "Data Officer", "Data Consultant",
    "MPH Epidemiology Track", "Statistician", "World Travel"
  ),
  start_date = c(
    "May 2016", "September 2016", "August 2014", "August 2018",
    "August 2018", "June 2021", "August 2018", "March 2023", "May 2024", "May 2024", "August 2019",
    "October 2025", "April 2025"
  ),
  end_date = c(
    "August 2016", "June 2018", "May 2016", "December 2022",
    "December 2022", "February 2023", "December 2022", "May 2024", "April 2025", "August 2024",
    "December 2021", "April 2026", "September 2025"
  ),
  activity_type = c(
    "Research", "Research", "Education", "Education",
    "Research", "Data Analysis", "Research", "Data Analysis", "Data Analysis",
    "Data Analysis", "Education", "Data Analysis", "Fun"
  )
) |>
 mutate(
  start_date = parse_date_time(paste0(start_date, "-01"), orders = "B Y-d"),
  end_date   = parse_date_time(paste0(end_date, "-01"), orders = "B Y-d")
) |> 
  arrange(start_date) |>
  mutate(activity = fct_reorder(activity, start_date))

# --- Plot ---
anim <- ggplot(df, aes(
  y = activity,
  x = start_date,
  xend = end_date,
  color = activity_type
)) +
  geom_segment(
    linewidth = 6,
    lineend = "round"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = end_date, label = activity),
    hjust = -0.2,
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_x_datetime(
    date_labels = "%Y",
    date_breaks = "2 years",
    limits = c(
      min(df$start_date),
      max(df$end_date) + months(12)
    ),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.15))
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(
    title = "Professional Timeline",
    subtitle = "Year: {format(frame_along, '%Y')}",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    color = NULL   # 👈 removes legend title
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(5.5, 40, 5.5, 5.5)
  ) +
  transition_reveal(along = start_date) +
  ease_aes("linear")



# --- Render MP4 ---
animate(
  anim,
  width = 1200,
  height = 676,
  units = "px",
  fps = 24,
  duration = 10,
  renderer = av_renderer("timeline.mp4"),
  device = "ragg_png"
)


```

<div style="max-width: 800px; margin: 2rem auto;">
  <video autoplay loop muted playsinline style="width:100%; height:auto;">
    <source src="timeline.mp4" type="video/mp4">
  </video>
</div>
